summary.prose: The build adds a pure failure classifier, gives the store's finish() the retrying branch and retry-now, makes a claude or codex error result a failure instead of a silent done, teaches the runner to report whether a turn acted and why it failed, and lets a retried turn run without a second user row. It then bounds the busy outcome write at 60 seconds, adds the retry-now action and the attempt and countdown on the outbox row, and closes with the constraint scoring and a live hand check. Each store rule is proved with two connections on one file, each worker and runner rule with fake timers, and the webview on a fake DOM.

tasks.title: Failure classifier module and retry constants
tasks.summary: Add vscode-plugin/src/chat/chat-failure.ts (vscode-free, pure): classifyFailure(message): InfraCause with conservative patterns written from the messages cli-adapter.ts produces and the daemon's isTransientCliError (overloaded, rate limit, 429 and 5xx, timeouts, connection failures map to their causes; the not-authenticated text and the CLIs' unauthorised, invalid key and login-required texts map to auth; 'CLI not found' (ENOENT) and any unmatched text map to other; passing start-up failures such as EAGAIN map to spawn), plus the constants RETRY_DELAYS_MS = [10000, 60000, 300000] and MAX_INFRA_RETRIES = 3. Nothing calls it yet.

the adapter's not-authenticated text and the CLIs' unauthorised and invalid key texts map to auth
CLI not found and any unmatched text, including a model refusal, map to other

tasks.title: Store: finish() retrying branch and retryNow
tasks.summary: In chat-queue-store.ts give finish() the retrying branch for a failed outcome: when cause is spawn, rate-limit, overloaded, network or timeout, acted is false and the row's attempts are below MAX_INFRA_RETRIES, write state retrying, attempts+1, next_attempt_at = now + RETRY_DELAYS_MS[attempts] and keep the error; otherwise failed with the error; the lease row is deleted in the same transaction in every case. Add retryNow(seq) to ChatQueueStore: UPDATE a retrying row's next_attempt_at to now, attempts unchanged, returning whether it matched.

tasks.title: Carry the provider's error text on done ok:false and treat it as a failure
tasks.summary: Add the optional message field to the done TurnEvent in stream-events.ts; make the claude result mapper (cli-adapter.ts ~:655) set it from obj.result when is_error is true and the codex result mapper (~:781) set it from the error text; carry it through both doneEvent wrappers (live and resumed) with the session id; make onTerminal in chat-panel.ts treat done with ok:false as a failure (q.error = message, or 'the turn ended with an error' when there is none) so settleQueued resolves failed. This alone turns a failed claude or codex turn from done into failed before any retry exists, adds a regression test so it cannot be recorded as done again, and finds and updates every existing test that pinned the old done behaviour (named in the build summary).

tasks.title: Runner: acted tracking, classification, logging
tasks.summary: In chat-panel.ts the queued-turn runner tracks acted: set when the queued turn emits a tool-call, file-edit or tool-result event and never cleared, including across an approval re-run. settleQueued resolves a failed turn as {kind:'failed', error, acted, cause: classifyFailure(error)} and logs every failed turn's cause and error text through the chat logger. The 'the chat no longer exists' failure stays acted:false with no cause.

tasks.title: Retried turn: skipUserRow, the stored retry line and the sign-in line
tasks.summary: Add the skipUserRow option to runTurn/startTurn in chat-panel.ts: no user row pushed to the stored transcript, no echo, title check skipped and no second save, while the prompt is still sent to the CLI; the queued-turn runner passes it when message.attempts > 0. Add persistInfo (appendEvent plus post with the row index, as followLiveTurn does): the runner stores and posts 'the turn failed with <cause>; retrying (attempt n of 3)' when a retried message starts, and on an auth failure stores and posts one line naming the CLI's login command. Streamed partial text and the failed attempt's error row stay in the transcript. A normal turn's shared startTurn path is pinned unchanged.

tasks.title: Worker: bound a busy outcome write at 60 s
tasks.summary: In chat-queue-worker.ts bound the retry of a busy outcome write: finishNow keeps the outcome in pendingFinish and retries each tick for at most BUSY_GIVE_UP_MS (60000 ms); then the worker stops retrying, logs an error and posts one chat note that the queue could not record the message's result and that reloading the window recovers it. The reload is recovered by S003's same-windowKey lease rule (the lease is freed at once, the message fails with a resend, the queue moves on).
acceptanceChecks: a busy outcome write is retried each tick for 60 s and the outcome is written when the store frees up inside the bound

tasks.title: Retry-now: worker action, host handling and the retrying row in the webview
tasks.summary: Add 'retry-now' to the worker's act (retryNow then an immediate tick; refused with a note on any other row); handle outbox-retry-now in the chat host's outbox action switch beside cancel, dismiss and resend; in the webview script draw, for a retrying row, 'attempt n of 3', a countdown to nextAttemptAt that ticks, a retry-now button and the existing cancel button; the chat-outbox projection already carries attempt and nextAttemptAt. This task also carries the worker-level test of the whole retry progression against the real store (a retrying head is held until due, then runs; three failed retries end failed and the next message runs), so it is not lost.

tasks.title: Closing: k1-k5, crosswalk, deferred amendments and the live hand check
tasks.summary: Score the Epic constraints k1-k5 against the finished change in the BUILD summary; carry the c-id crosswalk (c11 and c12 to read:store-retry-surface, c13 and c3 to read:worker-and-outbox); list the deferred HLD additions for the Epic-end batch (sc1 retryNow, sc4 retry-now action, sc5 outbox-retry-now completion, and S003's markNotDeliveredIfHead, presenceOf, holderGone and the same-windowKey takeOver rule). Run the live hand check with a real provider failure: a passing provider failure before acting waits, shows its countdown and runs again; retry-now runs it at once; a failure after an edit stays failed; check the classifier against the logged texts. If no real failure can be produced, record the check as not run with the reason, and record a fault-injection run (a fake CLI that prints an overload result) as evidence of the wiring, clearly labelled as such.
